name: p31-design-mcp
description: P31 Design System MCP Server — DTCG token resolution, component schemas, usage audit, layout generation, validation, auto-fix suggestions. 8 tools for the P31 quantum design system.

tools.name: token_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a DTCG token path (e.g. --p31-accent) to its computed value with refs resolved.

tools.name: component_schema
tools.description: Get the full schema definition for a named component (props, slots, states, accessibility).

tools.name: component_usage
tools.description: List which HTML/TSX files use a given component, with line numbers.

tools.name: token_list
tools.description: List all available DTCG tokens grouped by category (color, spacing, typography, etc.).

tools.name: layout_generate
tools.description: Generate a responsive layout scaffold from a description (header/sidebar/content/footer).

tools.name: validate_component
tools.description: Validate a component against P31 design invariants (glass, spoons, WCAG, accent).

tools.name: audit_tokens
tools.description: Audit a CSS/TSX file for hardcoded colors, missing token references, and WCAG contrast violations.

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description: Suggest a fix for a specific design violation (auto-fixable token swaps, glass panel upgrades, etc.).
